summary: One bounded adversarial round on Phase 1 at role base 787e846d. Commit 6d80fba0 adds tests/storytime-card-adversarial.test.ts with 20 tests. The file alone gives Test Files 1 passed (1) and Tests 20 passed (20). PROJECT_TESTS gives Test Files 11 passed (11) and Tests 155 passed (155), which is 135 plus 20. owned tsc errors: 0. No Blocker. The cap boundary, the time formats, the outDir match, the mixed call, the cost-row parse, and the pool re-check all hold. One Major marks the section 6 allowed set, which does not name the new test file. Five Nits mark stale strategy text, a declared type that the parser does not fill, and two guard edges.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-N1 [Major] adversarial-testing: measure/tracks/asset_storytime_l2_cards_20261106/test-strategy.md section 6 (line 380) allows only tests/storytime-card-(guards|specs|fixtures)\.test\.ts$. Commit 6d80fba0 adds tests/storytime-card-adversarial.test.ts, which spec.md owned paths allow as tests/storytime-card-*.test.ts. The phase-acceptance allowed-set check counts one own file outside the set. Rationale: the strategy predates the adversarial round. Owner: strategy or orchestrator, not Green. Fix: widen the regex to tests/storytime-card-[a-z-]+\.test\.ts$, or add a residual-risk row like the one for storytime-judge-batch.d.mts.

ADV-N2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: measure/tracks/asset_storytime_l2_cards_20261106/test-strategy.md:221 (section 4.3, outDir match) states Exact string equality with CARD_RUN.outDir and A variant (trailing slash, ..) is not a card spec. spec.md states that classifyOutDir works by resolved path, and the code returns card for both variants. Review A and Review B probed both variants and accepted card. Rationale: a test written from section 4.3 fails. ADVC7 and ADVC8 record the code behaviour.

ADV-N3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: scripts/storytime-muse-guards.d.mts:11-20 declares CostRow.version, CostRow.inputs and CostRow.size as required strings, but parseCostsTsv (scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:158-165) never sets them. A consumer that reads row.version gets undefined typed as string. Rationale: no current consumer reads those three fields, because the judge batch has its own parser. Fix: set the fields in the parser, or mark them optional in the declaration.

ADV-N4 [Nit] adversarial-testing: scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:300-301 and scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:246 do not validate --tries as an integer. A fractional value such as 2.5 makes the projection reserve 2.5 margins, while doLine launches Math.ceil(2.5) = 3 calls, and the try guard compares count + 2.5 with the cap. ADVC19 proves the three-try cap holds for every value tested and that the three calls land on 1.60 USD on a 0.01 cost grid. Rationale: the under-reserve is below one margin, and a cost row above 0.01 USD would let the run pass the cap by up to one margin.

ADV-N5 [Nit] adversarial-testing: tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts:66 (CG3) asserts not.toMatch(/(?:cap|report)[A-Za-z_]*\s*=\s*(?:1\.6|0\.8)/i) and runs only on scripts/storytime-muse.mjs and scripts/storytime-judge-batch.mjs. A second owner written as an object property (capUsd: 1.6) in any other file is not flagged. ADVC20 runs a stronger scan over scripts/ and tests/ with a seeded control, and finds only the guard module and the card test files today. Rationale: the acceptance search is wider than the CG3 test.

ADV-N6 [Nit] adversarial-testing, RB-4 extension: scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:147-168 and :171-172. A costs.tsv header without a time column gives every row time '', so sinceStart drops every row. spendTotal and countTries then read 0 while usage_cost values are present, so the cap and the try cap stop working on that file. RB-4 names only the missing cost column in its disposition. ADVC6 records the behaviour. Rationale: the tool always writes the full header, so the cause is a hand-edited or corrupted file and the trusted-file disposition of RB-4 applies.

ADVC1 (cap boundary): at spend 1.59 a color call is refused with projected spend 1.6100 over cap 1.6, and one line call is allowed. At 1.60 and 1.61 both commands are refused with the spend message and code 3. Control: at 1.58 both are allowed.

ADVC2 (convergence): from start 0, 1.5, 1.58 and 1.59 a repeated single line call runs until refusal, and the spend after the last allowed call is always at or below 1.60 and above 1.59. From start 1.60 and 1.61 no call is allowed.

ADVC3 (float sums): 158 rows of 0.01 allow one more line call and sum to at most 1.60. 160 rows refuse the next call with over cap 1.6. 159 rows are not pinned, as section 8 requires. Control: 159 elements rows plus 1 top row also refuse.
ADVC4 (time formats): a missing time cell, a non-date cell, a lowercase z and a trailing space each give spend 0 and 0 tries. Control: a well-formed row at the start time gives 0.5 spend and 1 try.

ADVC6 (missing time column): a header with usage_cost but no time column parses the row with cost 0.5, yet spendTotal reads 0 and countTries reads 0, so runGuards reports spend 0 and refuses nothing. Control: the same row with the full header counts.

ADVC7 (outDir spellings): CARD_DIR, a trailing slash, a trailing /. , ./CARD_DIR, three .. spellings that resolve to the card folder all classify card. Controls: cards/muse/elements is invalid and w03/muse is restart.

ADVC8 (under cards): ten paths at or below the child cards folder classify card or invalid and never restart, which would leave the spend unguarded because the restart scan skips cards. The list exercises both allowed classes.

ADVC9 (outDir controls): an empty outDir, an absolute path under os.tmpdir(), a four-level .. escape, cards/muse/../../../.. and w01/muse2 all classify invalid. A spec without outDir and a week folder classify restart.

ADVC10 (child folders): a temp unit root with w01, Cards, CARDS, cards2, card and cards gives restart scan children CARDS, Cards, card, cards2, w01 and card scan child cards. RB2-4 pin: a Cards spelling classifies restart.

ADVC11 (card symlinks): a folder symlink cards to an outside folder holding 0.90 USD gives card spend 0.90. A file symlink on the real card costs file also gives 0.90. The card scan uses existsSync and readFileSync, so both links are followed.
ADVC12 (RB2-2 pin): a folder symlink w10 to an outside folder holding 0.90 USD classifies restart but the restart scan reads 0. Control: the same file in a real w10 folder gives 0.90.

ADVC13 (mixed call): four CLI orderings (card+restart, restart+card, card+card+restart, card+no-outDir) each exit 3, print mixes card specs, print no no key, and leave the card costs file byte-identical. Control: a card-only call on the same repository passes the guard and prints no key, so the no-key assertion can fail.

ADVC14 (notice line): a card call at spend 0.90 prints card run: cap 1.6 USD and notice: spend 0.9000 USD at or above report point 0.8, and no report point 0.5. This covers the notice row of section 4.3, which has no test in the guards file.

ADVC15 (cost-row parse): a negative cost cell is kept at -0.5 and lowers the spend (RB-4 pin). A blank cost cell reads 0. Extra columns do not move the cost or the note. A row shorter than the header reads 0 cost. A header-only file holds no rows. A row with a blank first cell is dropped. A missing card costs file gives spend 0 and allows a call. Control: a well-formed row reads 0.01 and kind color.
ADVC16 (RB-4 pin): a header with time, row and kind but no usage_cost parses the row with cost 0, so spendTotal reads 0. Control: the full header reads 0.01.
ADVC17 (pool re-check): a color re-check passes at 1.58 and refuses at 1.5801. A line re-check with tries 3 passes at 1.57 and refuses at 1.5701. Both match the pre-pool projection.

ADVC18 (RB2-1 pin): two runGuards calls on one unchanged cost file at 1.58 both pass and return the same spend, so the re-check holds no reservation and a call in flight is invisible until logCall writes its row. RB2-1 stays an accepted Phase 2 operating rule.

ADVC19 (try cap): for counts 0 to 3 and --tries 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, -1 and abc, every allowed decision keeps count plus the launched calls at or below 3. Control: an integer fourth try is refused with count 3. A fractional 2.5 at spend 1.57 is allowed, and after three 0.01 line rows the next call is refused at spend 1.60.

ADVC20 (single owner): the stronger owner pattern flags a seeded object literal capUsd: 1.6, and the CG3 pattern does not. The same walker over scripts/ and tests/ returns only scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs, tests/storytime-card-guards.test.ts and tests/storytime-card-adversarial.test.ts, all allowed by name.

Probe results behind the tests: a card call at spend 1.60 in a temporary repository exits 3 with refused: spend 1.6000 USD plus 0.01 over cap 1.6; at 1.50 it prints the card banner and the notice, then exits 1 with no key; a mixed call exits 3 with the mix message. No probe made a provider call and no probe read the real Workbooks env file.
Heavy lock: the first targeted run printed heavy-run: lock wait over 600 s with holder PID 2752411 and then ran. The two later runs and the typecheck waited under 30 minutes.
